title: Non-vacuous precondition
contract: A proposed precondition for an operation accepting exactly integers 0..2 must admit precisely those values; in particular a witness must exist.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Candidate admission equals explicit accepted set {0,1,2}; at least one required witness exists.

variants.description: Reject every input using x>2 and x<0.
